system.description:
At 5th level, your attacking cantrips increase in power just like anyone else’s, gaining additional damage dice. But you also gain the ability to choose additional targets, splitting the damage dice between them, or even striking the same target with multiple attack rolls. Your @UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.class-features.Item.dJv6dpK5cvhuVfGb]{Empowered Casting} damage bonus applies to each successful attack or failed save.

You may also use this ability with cantrips that require saving throws, but only if the spell does not target an area of effect. @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.wb05jikqneh34h1s]{Pestilence}, for example, cannot be splitcast, while @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.tvtm60k5wxyki9qc]{Sacred Flame} could.
